title: The Mercy of the Filter
evidence_boundary: This is a philosophical interpretation of subjective DMT experiences, not evidence that altered perception reveals unfiltered or ultimate reality.

scenes.text: We call ordinary consciousness clear because it is the only clarity we remember using.
scenes.visual: a person carefully polishing a transparent visor while the surrounding landscape stays softly blurred

scenes.text: The world appears direct: light enters, sound arrives, objects sit obediently where we left them.
scenes.visual: a quiet still-life room with sunbeams, gentle sound ripples, and neatly placed objects

scenes.text: But perception may be less like a window and more like a survival dashboard.
scenes.visual: a car dashboard glowing in darkness while the immense engine remains hidden

scenes.text: A dashboard does not show the entire engine. It shows the few signals needed to keep driving.
scenes.visual: a cutaway machine with hundreds of moving parts beneath four simple gauges

scenes.text: Your senses discard almost everything, then present the remainder as reality.
scenes.visual: streams of color, sound, and texture passing through a narrow brass funnel

scenes.text: That is not a flaw. A map survives by refusing to become the territory.
scenes.visual: a small folded map floating above a vast mountain range, river, forest, and city

scenes.text: DMT may loosen that compression, but loosened does not automatically mean more truthful.
scenes.visual: a tightly wound camera lens opening as several overlapping images spill through

scenes.text: A broken radio can reveal hidden frequencies and still distort the music.
scenes.visual: an antique radio surrounded by beautiful but warped luminous waveforms

scenes.text: The profound possibility is not that the filter imprisons us. It may protect us.
scenes.visual: a thin glass shelter protecting a candle from a violent storm of light

scenes.text: Imagine reality as white light too intense for a finite nervous system to hold.
scenes.visual: a brilliant white sun pouring through a narrow opening into a dark chamber

scenes.text: The mind becomes stained glass, dividing the unbearable whole into colors a human life can touch.
scenes.visual: a human silhouette formed from stained glass dividing white light into vivid colors

scenes.text: Space becomes distance. Time becomes sequence. The ocean of information becomes one cup on one table.
scenes.visual: an immense ocean curving through a glass vessel and settling into one cup on a wooden table

scenes.text: Then the filter opens wider, and categories begin flooding into one another.
scenes.visual: a library, garden, workshop, and night sky flowing together through an opened floodgate

scenes.text: A leaf becomes architecture. Sound acquires weight. Thoughts arrive wearing landscapes.
scenes.visual: a green leaf unfolding into a cathedral while heavy sound rings become distant hills

scenes.text: Information stops behaving like a message and becomes weather surrounding the listener.
scenes.visual: a lone listener standing inside a storm made from symbols, colors, maps, and musical waves

scenes.text: The entities may be meaning compressed into faces because faces are how human minds negotiate importance.
scenes.visual: many streams of abstract light condensing into several expressive ceremonial faces

scenes.text: The sacred feeling may be infinity passing through machinery designed for breakfast, traffic, and remembering passwords.
scenes.visual: a breakfast table and traffic signal connected to an enormous cosmic machine overhead

scenes.text: We often resent our limitations because we imagine boundlessness would feel like freedom.
scenes.visual: a person at the edge of a vast horizon loosening a safety rope around the waist

scenes.text: But an eye without an aperture receives so much light that it loses the picture.
scenes.visual: a camera aperture opening too wide until a detailed landscape becomes pure white

scenes.text: A photograph needs darkness around each exposure. A song needs silence between its notes.
scenes.visual: a darkroom photograph developing beside a musical instrument separated by quiet gaps of light

scenes.text: Perhaps the ego is not merely a prison. Perhaps it is the small opening that allows anything coherent to appear.
scenes.visual: a tiny circular aperture framing one perfectly coherent garden inside surrounding radiance

scenes.text: When ordinary perception returns, the spoon is only a spoon again, and this can feel like exile.
scenes.visual: a single metal spoon resting on a quiet table after a colorful storm has passed

scenes.text: Yet maybe the ordinary world is an astonishing translation, not a diminished one.
scenes.visual: an ordinary city street revealed as precisely aligned layers of light, depth, motion, and sound

scenes.text: What if reality is filtered not to hide infinity from you, but to let you love one piece of it at a time?
scenes.visual: two hands holding one glowing fragment while an infinite field of light extends behind it
